items.text: According to the World Wealth Report 2026, leading wealth management firms will distinguish themselves by how effectively they deploy augmented intelligence to empower relationship managers, reimagine client engagement, and institutionalize personalization at scale.
items.quote: leading firms will distinguish themselves by how effectively they deploy augmented intelligence to empower RMs, reimagine client engagement, and institutionalize personalization at scale.

items.text: The World Wealth Report 2026 expects AI to handle data analysis and pattern recognition so that relationship managers can focus on life planning, deeper advisory work, and judgment calls requiring human empathy and contextual understanding.
items.quote: AI handles data analysis and pattern recognition collected during client conversations so that RMs can focus on life planning, deeper advisory work, and judgment calls that require human empathy and contextual understanding.

items.text: The World Wealth Report 2026 expects AI to proactively generate insights and predict triggers so relationship managers engage clients at moments of real relevance rather than in response to periodic reviews or client-initiated interactions.
items.quote: Proactively generate insights: AI predicts triggers and opportunities, enabling RMs to engage clients at moments of real relevance, rather than in response to periodic reviews or client-initiated interactions.

items.text: The World Wealth Report 2026 describes a reimagined, AI-powered desktop that delivers a humanlike, empathetic, personalized, and contextual client experience while maintaining trust and human oversight.
items.quote: a reimagined, AI-powered desktop that delivers a humanlike, empathetic, personalized, and contextual experience through three integrated capabilities.

items.text: Schwab expects AI to help create personalized and deeper client relationships with clients it cannot currently serve at scale one-to-one, and will roll out portfolio insights, an AI-enabled experience delivering tailored insights about clients' investment portfolios.
items.quote: AI can help us create personalized and deeper relationships with the clients we can't currently serve at scale with one-to-one relationships... we will begin the rollout of portfolio insights, an AI-enabled experience that will deliver tailored insights to our clients about their investment portfolios

items.text: Schwab notes that more than 90% of U.S. investors still prefer human involvement in addition to AI, indicating advice is expected to combine human and AI rather than replace the human element.
items.quote: 77% of U.S. investors use AI today, though more than 90% still prefer human involvement in addition to AI.

items.text: Schwab's goal is to be the leader for clients who want an omnichannel experience as well as those who may want limited interaction, with AI investments supporting both.
